name: hero-home
prompt: This is Luna at home in her flat, the real woman under the city AI's version of her: about 27, tall and slim, with adult proportions and long legs. Her face, her dull ash-blonde hair in its plain, fairly thin high ponytail, and her old goggle over her right eye, exactly as in the reference. At home she wears comfortable old clothes instead of her coat: a long, loose knit cardigan in faded grey-brown, pilled and soft, open at the front and hanging to mid-thigh; under it a faded grey T-shirt covering her stomach completely; soft, baggy charcoal sweatpants gathered at the ankles; thick grey wool socks in worn felt slippers. The same flat-shaded style: two or three flat tones per surface, crisp edges, no texture.
concierge: Luna at home as the city AI shows her: the same beautiful woman, her figure, her glossy black ponytail with hot-pink and teal streaks and the sleek ice-blue visor over her right eye only exactly as in the reference, in chic, cosy loungewear instead of her coat: a long, soft blush-pink knit cardigan, open at the front and hanging to mid-thigh; under it a fitted white top covering her stomach completely; soft light grey lounge trousers; fluffy white slippers. Light make-up. The same flat-shaded style: two or three flat tones per surface, crisp edges, no texture.
framing: One full-length figure in exact profile, seen straight from the side and facing right, standing in a neutral pose for animation: arms hanging relaxed and slightly away from the body, hands empty and open, legs straight and a little apart so both are fully visible, nothing held and nothing crossing the body. Feet at the bottom of the frame. Even, soft, frontal lighting with no cast shadows and no rim light. Transparent background, the whole figure in frame with a little space around it, no ground, no text, no border.

left.raw: Seen from her left side: the goggles' left lens over her left eye, the strap around her head, the ponytail behind.
left.concierge: Seen from her left side: her left eye is uncovered, made up, with no visor or glow over it at all; the visor is on her right eye, out of sight. Only the pink band of her ponytail and the hair show above her ear.

parts.right: Seen from her right side: the goggles' right lens over her right eye in raw view, the glowing visor over her right eye in the Concierge's.
parts.reshape: The ponytail piece, on its own at the far left of the sheet, is fuller: about one and a half times as wide, with spiky strands, and it stays a separate piece with clear empty space between it and the head, never touching it. The torso's bust is fuller and rounder under the white top, the collar, shoulders, waist and hips staying where they are.
